**actor-check's deny branch states what it did not evaluate (#673)**

**Actor:** fix/issue-673-actor-checks-deny-branch-cannot-report-t (agente)
**Fuente:** issue #673 / plainfiles save on vm

The deny-set branch in `evaluateActor` returns BEFORE the tier branch, and `signedNotes` is declared INSIDE the tier branch — so the refusal could not name a signature even in principle. "read and not sufficient" and "never read at all" came out byte-identical, and it is always the second. Measured cost on PR #665: the maintainer, having signed correctly, removed and re-applied the label and re-ran the jobs.

The ordering was NOT touched (#358 Q5 holds: a denied identity must never slip through lite's narrower evidence). `describeUnevaluatedSignedEvidence` reports and never votes — level, verdict and branch order are unchanged in every case.

Non-obvious: the honest fix is NOT an unconditional note. Three states had to stay distinct, and two of them are traps.
1. Non-admissible block present: promising "re-apply as a human and this signature will be read" is FALSE — re-labeling admits nothing while the block is stale. It carries the source's own diagnosis instead.
2. standard/regulated: `signedEvidenceSources` is never consulted outside lite, so there a signature is not evidence that was SKIPPED — it is not evidence. A note there would be #669's shape (a confident answer about the wrong subject), so the helper returns '' on every non-lite tier.
An unconditional append passes the positive test and is a worse defect than the one it replaces — which is why the negative controls are the load-bearing tests.

It reads through the same injected `signedEvidenceSources` list the lite branch uses, so a source added tomorrow is described without a second edit.

Mutation-proved on four axes: lite-only guard removed -> 2 red; deny branch stops calling the helper -> 4 red; 'NOT evaluated' -> 'not sufficient' -> 3 red; the no-block silence removed -> 3 red. 3829/3829 green restored.

**Where:** brain/scripts/vcs/actor-check.mjs, brain/scripts/vcs/actor-check.test.mjs
